title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
blurb: OpenAI's open-weight MoE reasoning models: alternating banded and dense attention with learned sinks, YaRN-extended RoPE, and MXFP4 expert weights.
intro: gpt-oss is a pre-norm MoE decoder. Attention layers alternate between a 128-token band and full causal attention, use grouped-query attention, and give every head a learned sink logit. RoPE is extended to 131k tokens with YaRN. Each MoE layer routes tokens to the top 4 experts, whose SwiGLU activations are clamped, and the expert weights are stored in MXFP4. The steps build each of these components; the capstone wires one full block.
